text.text: chore: .greptile/ moved to .github/, staging files dropped

*PR #134* (merged).

*Changes:*
• `.greptile/greptile.json` -> `.github/greptile/greptile.json` (bot config now lives next to the other CI / bot configs in `.github/`)
• Added `gateway/target/**` to the Greptile `ignorePaths`
• `SETUP.md` updated to point at the new path
• Deleted `.m1.json` ... `.m6.json` -- the six leftover staging files used to seed the seven milestones when the project was bootstrapped; they're no longer needed and they broke the convention of "every top-level entry is a real artefact"

*Stats:* 1 file renamed, 6 files deleted, 1 file modified. +5 / -9 lines.

*Final top level of the repo:*
```
.coderabbit.yaml        # CodeRabbit bot config (stays at root by their convention)
.github/                # CI workflows, release-drafter.yml, greptile/greptile.json
.gitignore
Cargo.toml              # umbrella workspace
README.md
SETUP.md
backend/                # room-service, doc-service, latex-service
docker-compose.yml
docs/                   # ARCHITECTURE.md + refactor/done/
frontend/               # React/TS SPA (unchanged)
gateway/                # Rust axum API gateway
infra/                  # Dockerfiles, RabbitMQ topology, .env.example
packages/               # 9 reusable Rust crates
rust-toolchain.toml
sonar-project.properties
```

No `legacy/`, no `.greptile/`, no `.mN.json` staging files, no Python.
